reason: The run depended on live Wikimedia requests and 38/50 samples failed technically: 27 Unicode URL failures and 11 Wikimedia HTTP 429 responses. It must not be used as the Louvre recognition accuracy baseline.
retained_signal: Among the 12 valid endpoint results, Top-1 and Top-3 were 8.33%, indicating candidate identification needed improvement even though the 50-sample benchmark itself was invalid.
replacement_plan: Use locally acquired rights-approved RecognitionAsset fixtures only, with separate VISION_METADATA_ONLY and hybrid Stage-2 benchmarks.
